861.description:
Reception will be walking to St Paul’s Church with staff for their first church service. Parents/carers invited to attend church.

Children will be collected directly from the church at the end of the service. Any children attending Extra Club will be walked back to school by staff.

Please be aware that children will not bring their school bags or water bottles home following the service.

865.description: Please make sure children come to school in the correct uniform, with a cardigan/jumper and tie.

866.description: Children can wear something yellow, like a ribbon, bow, wristband or socks with their uniform. Donations can be made using the following link: https://fundraise.youngminds.org.uk/fundraisers/jthomas/hello-yellow
